scope: Broadened 3D carrier research around a source-generated AC1032 AcDs/SAB loss reproducer and FreeCAD's DWG-to-DXF-to-consumer qualification boundary.

method.kind: Primary Autodesk format reference plus current project source, documentation, and issue reports
method.evidenceRule: Separate published DXF contract, ODA DWG container layout, peer-reported output, native consumer limits, and independently verified geometry semantics. Do not treat issue reports or file existence as a completed runtime qualification.

findings.evidence: LibreDWG issue #1411 reports a scratch-generated AC1032 DXF with one REGION and SAB created through ezdxf's public body_from_mesh(cube()) and export_dxf APIs. The issue author reports 5,489 bytes before conversion and no SAB/ACDSDATA after a LibreDWG 0.14.8593 DXF-to-DWG-to-DXF run, despite the REGION record surviving. The recipe and result were not independently executed in this research pass; the byte count is observational, not a fixed contract.
findings.confidence: Concrete public reproduction recipe with version-bound issue-author result; not independently reproduced and not a claim about all LibreDWG versions.
findings.planUse: Use as an optional ephemeral composed-gate input after pinning ezdxf. Assert source-carrier and ACDSDATA shape before conversion, then record exact output body/hash, section/record/owner association and reread disposition. Do not add a Python runtime dependency or commit generated files.

findings.evidence: Autodesk's DXF table specifies inline proprietary groups 1/3, modeler version group 70, and group 350 history soft-owner reference. The general group-code table says 350-series soft ownership IDs are translated during INSERT/XREF. These entity fields do not define the separate modern DXF ACDSDATA or DWG AcDs DataStorage envelope. ODA v5.4.1 defines DWG section and owner/index structure separately from the incomplete/undocumented modeler stream.
findings.confidence: Published format reference for documented DXF fields and ODA-defined DWG structure; no claim about every producer variant.
findings.planUse: Keep four carrier routes distinct and make history handle/owner mapping a separate edit/remap closure gate from opaque body replay.

findings.evidence: Current FreeCAD importDWG.py converts DWG to DXF and delegates to importDXF; its wrapper reports success when the expected output file exists. FreeCAD documentation states its stock DXF import/export has limitations for proprietary 3D ACIS carrier data; issue #18454's maintainer response distinguishes readable explicit entities from ACIS blobs that FreeCAD cannot read as solids. Importer backend/mode and converter selection are configurable.
findings.confidence: Current mutable source/documentation plus maintainer response; native runtime behavior was not executed and source must be pinned for qualification.
findings.planUse: Separate external converter transport qualification from native consumer acceptance. Pin exact app/converter/backend/preferences; verify process result and fresh output independently. Do not score stock FreeCAD's unsupported ACIS B-rep path as a positive semantic oracle; preserve 2D and explicitly supported geometry checks.

implementationReadinessChanges: First close local raw-frame pairing/invalidation, owner-chain reachability, and AcDs page/index/handle closure with in-memory generated controls.
At one optional composed checkpoint, generate a scratch AC1032 REGION/SAB DXF from a pinned ezdxf API; bind observations by tool/version and hashes, not by an assumed 5,489-byte result.

Capture converter identity, command/options, exit status, fresh output, target DWG version, AcDs section, entity-record association, exact payload hash and reread disposition; entity counts and success banners are insufficient.

Keep B-rep acceptance separate: independently authored dimensions, an eligible reader/kernel, topology validity, and a known-answer operation are required; record parser and kernel lineage separately.

Qualify stock FreeCAD as a converter handoff plus scoped DXF consumer, not as an ACIS B-rep reader. If visible/editable ACIS solids in FreeCAD become a hard requirement, select a separately qualified extension or another consumer.
